---
title: "DEG analyse"
description: "A focused differential-expression utility for compatible count-style datasets."
---

## Scope

The **DEG Analyse** toolkit is separate from ProtVis's main **DEP analysis**. Use the main DEP module for normalized protein-abundance comparisons. Use DEG Analyse only when the supplied dataset matches the statistical assumptions and input format expected by the toolkit.

## Recommended workflow

1. Confirm whether the input represents raw counts, normalized continuous values, or another measurement type.
2. Provide the required sample grouping information.
3. Run the statistical model only after checking that its distributional assumptions match the input.
4. Inspect effect size, p-value and adjusted p-value together.
5. Export the full result table before thresholding.
6. State the model and threshold explicitly in downstream figures and Methods.

::: {.callout-important}
Do not use an RNA-seq count model on continuous proteomics intensities merely because both datasets have samples in columns. Data type determines the appropriate statistical model.
:::
